To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the financial sentiment words are more important than the whole texts in the risk prediction; (2) the financial reports of companies with higher financial risk tend to contain more negative financial sentiment words than the reports of companies with lower risk; and (3) the financial reports with higher financial risk contain more negative financial words and fewer positive financial words than the reports with lower risk.

(1) the financial sentiment words are the most important words for risk prediction; (2) the risk prediction results are comparable to using the entire texts in financial reports; (3) the financial sentiment lexicon can be used to predict financial risk; (4) the risk prediction models can be applied to other financial applications.

the text in financial reports, the so-called soft financial information, is useful for financial risk prediction, and financial sentiment words are particularly useful in this regard; this is a novel and important finding.
